verdict.justification: B has a modest edge because its visible formulas explicitly support the requested selected-week range and YTD reporting. Its helper formula 'IF(AND(L5>=Dashboard!$D$5,L5<=Dashboard!$D$6),"Yes","No")' distinguishes the selected reporting period, while 'IF(L5<=Dashboard!$D$6,"Yes","No")' separately identifies YTD records through the ending week. Both deliverables accurately reproduce the nine operators’ Week 1 daily outputs and assignments, and both use appropriate blank-aware average and total formulas. B also provides clear source attribution and explains that future daily outputs are intentionally blank rather than fabricated. The supplied extracts stop within the data worksheet, so neither workbook’s PivotTables, validation lists, charts, KPI summary, or full 48-week coverage can be verified; the preference for B is therefore based on its stronger visible reporting infrastructure rather than confirmed dashboard completeness.

decisive_issues.issue: Visible helper logic explicitly supports a selected start-to-end week range.
Separate YTD inclusion logic preserves cumulative reporting independently of the selected starting week.
